$comment: The control API's methods and notifications: what `xynolog control` serves, over JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line on stdin and stdout. Each method names the schema of its params and of its result, and each notification the schema of its params, by the schema's $id; each is a schema of control/. the consumer-owned generator generates the launcher's Go types and Desktop's TypeScript types from this table and the schemas it names, and the schemas themselves for both sides to validate against. contract/LAUNCHER-CONTROL.md is the contract's prose. `errorData`: the schema of a failed request's error data. `exclusive`: the request waits for every other exclusive request to end, and holds the others off until it does. `sends`: the notifications a request of the method may send besides notifications/progress, which any may.

methods.name: launcher.about
methods.docs: What the launcher is: its version, the API versions it speaks, the runtimes it detects. It reads none of the machine's state.

methods.name: roots.list
methods.docs: Every knowledge base this machine knows: xynolog roots.

methods.name: roots.init
methods.docs: Create and register a new local knowledge base: xynolog init.

methods.name: roots.forget
methods.docs: Remove one registry row, and no file: xynolog forget.

methods.name: status.snapshot
methods.docs: Each knowledge base's stack, and the services they share: xynolog status.

methods.name: stack.start
methods.docs: Start a stack, or some of its services: xynolog start.

methods.name: stack.stop
methods.docs: Stop a stack, or some of its services: xynolog stop.

methods.name: auth.login
methods.docs: Sign in at the issuer a stack's knowledge base trusts, by the device grant, and keep the session in the launcher's store: xynolog login. Exclusive while it finds the stack; the wait for the person is not.

methods.name: auth.logout
methods.docs: End the launcher's session for a stack: xynolog logout.

methods.name: identity.useradd
methods.docs: Create an account in a local knowledge base's launcher-managed Keycloak realm: xynolog useradd. A supplied password is secret request data and is never narrated or persisted; a generated password is returned once in the result.

methods.name: identity.users.list
methods.docs: List accounts in one local knowledge base's launcher-managed Keycloak realm. Passwords and tokens are never returned.

methods.name: logs.follow
methods.docs: Follow a stack's service logs until the client cancels or every source ends: xynolog logs. Exclusive while it finds the containers; the follow is not.

methods.name: settings.list
methods.docs: Every setting the launcher keeps: xynolog settings.

methods.name: settings.set
methods.docs: Set a setting, checked as a start would check it: xynolog settings <name> <value>.

methods.name: settings.unset
methods.docs: Return a setting to its default: xynolog settings <name> --unset.

methods.name: settings.path
methods.docs: Where a machine document is: xynolog settings <document> --path.

notifications.name: notifications/progress
notifications.docs: A line of what a request is doing.

notifications.name: notifications/userAction
notifications.docs: A sign-in waits for a person to enter a code.

notifications.name: notifications/log
notifications.docs: A line a followed service wrote.

notifications.name: notifications/cancelled
notifications.docs: The client gives up on a request.
